items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: And at that time Nam he was playing with that old man. Nam was playing with Dorsey. But later he was playing later after with Ullett.

ctx.x: And Bicu used to play the clarinet. Albert Gibberell used to play at times with him. And the old man Cantrell used to play banjo with him. Well they used to play together. Some of them had a big band there in Luley Oster. They had a flat for them from amongst them trees there on a Sunday night. Right in Luley Oster. Well I was living there in Luley Oster. And I used to hear them every night. That's the time I would start to play music then. But I had my own little band. Yeah. Yeah.
And at that time Nam he was playing with that old man. Nam was playing with Dorsey. But later he was playing later after with Ullett. Ullett was a branch band. Ullett.
